title: In Splunk Enterprise versions below 9.4.17, 10.0.12, 10.2.9, and 10.4.5, a user who does not hold the "admin" or…
description: Splunk Enterprise versions below 9.4.17, 10.0.12, 10.2.9, and 10.4.5 contain a vulnerability where users without 'admin' or 'power' roles can configure metric alerts via the REST API that execute searches with elevated privileges. This occurs due to improper enforcement of role-based authorization during metric alert configuration, allowing unauthorized users to access or modify data and disrupt the Splunk instance.
